gallery.filename: 2024 ToituTeTiriti WGTN 03.jpg
gallery.title: File:2024 ToituTeTiriti WGTN 03.jpg
gallery.artist: Pakoire
gallery.description:
Waitangi Day Solidarity Hīkoi, Te Whanganui-A-Tara Wellington 2024.
Estimated 5,000 people attended. Many signs stated: Toitū Te Tiriti (Honour Te Tiriti). Organised by the Pōneke Anti-Fascist Coalition with this statement, "We call on all allies to take action this year, and to join with us in showing up as strong Tangata Tiriti at a time when the foundations of Te Tiriti are under threat." Gathering at 10.30am with speeches at Pukeahu National War Memorial followed by a hīkoi (walk) to Waitangi Park down Tory Street.

gallery.artist: U.S. Department of State from United States
gallery.description: U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry thanks members of the U.S. Embassy Wellington staff on November 13, 2016, at the Pukeahu National War Memorial Park at Anzac Square in Wellington, New Zealand, after they helped arrange for him to lay a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Warrior, present U.S. medals to members of New Zealand’s armed forces who served alongside American troops, and dedicate the site of a new U.S. memorial in the park. [State Department Photo/ Public Domain]
